notes.title: Update v0.2.1
notes.content:
[b]Update v0.2.1[/b]
Notifications no longer appear if the level has been completed.
Inserted double checks for level completion or failure conditions. The failures were occurring because in one frame all the red LEDs on the level were red and then the blue LED was on. With the double checks, I added a small delay to avoid these types of situations.
Level 52 bug fixed: At level 52 I found a bug where the SW3 switch was listening to a wrong component.
Level 64 bug fixed: At level 64 the game object called NOR Gate 3 Inputs was listening to an incorrect component.
Level 75 visual bug fixed: In level 75, there was a visual bug where the striped line for the SW3 key output does not appear.
Level 85 bug fixed: At level 85, the level could be successfully completed with only 2 of the 3 LEDs lit.
Visual bug fixed in some levels: Some dotted lines were not appearing.

notes.title: Devlog - New Levels and Localization System
notes.content:
Hello everybody! All good?
I've finalized the game's translation system and now it will be easier to implement new languages in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44542757/cce8b776d8d355993325c830f3efdf22ea025603.gif[/img]

I also developed more than 10 new game levels with new electronic components, such as the 7-segment display, for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44542757/d2bfd78bb73a861f06797914637e864154f32be7.png[/img]
It is difficult to think about how to make the game more accessible to the vast majority of the public without requiring in-depth technical knowledge.
I'm working so that anyone can play without major difficulties.

[h3][b]REMEMBER, adding the game to your WISH LIST will help me a lot in launching the game! ːsteamhappyː[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Devlog - Localization System
notes.content:
Hello people, how are you?
I would like to inform you that we are working on the localization system and intensively developing new hand-built challenges.
We are doing some tests on the localization system and currently the game has the following languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] PT-BR
[/list]
In future devlog updates we will implement new languages and other features.
We now have 58 handcrafted levels completed and are planning to develop around 105 to 110 levels by the official launch of Electronics Puzzle Lab.

[h3][b]Please, consider add Electronics Puzzle Lab to your wishlist, this helps us sooo much![/b][/h3]
